verdict.rationale: Navan documents that it can manage expenses and issue reimbursements (docs-8). It also supports receipt scanning for on-the-go expenses (docs-24), manual expenses in its API (docs-4), approval workflows (docs-25), and per-transaction activity history (docs-43), so the core submit-and-reimburse flow is its own capability. However, the evidence never mentions how payouts are made or how fast they arrive. missing for 10: evidence of direct-deposit payout, reimbursement within days, employee-facing status tracking from submission to payout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
